findings.label: Incomplete enrichment layer testing
findings.description: Customer enricher has only 2 tests; order and billing enrichers have 0 tests. S3.1, S3.2, S3.3 specify 15+, 12+, 10+ tests respectively. Error paths (API timeout, cache failures, tenant isolation) lack coverage.

findings.label: Missing analytics dashboard unit tests
findings.description: MetricsDashboard (S3.9) has 4 async methods (get_summary_metrics, get_agent_performance, get_customer_outcomes, detect_anomalies) but zero unit tests. Database queries to materialized views are untested.

findings.label: Knowledge gap analyzer tests not implemented
findings.description: KnowledgeGapAnalyzer (S3.5) has no dedicated tests. Intent classification, gap scoring, and keyword fallback paths are untested.

findings.label: Health scorer model integration incomplete
findings.description: LightGBM model is trained and saved as account_health_lgb.pkl but is never loaded or used in predict()/explain() — scoring falls back to heuristic rule-based approach. SHAP explainability path uses fallback heuristics rather than actual model drivers.

findings.label: Acceptance test coverage incomplete
findings.description: K1/K2/K3 scenarios skip when golden_dataset fixture fails; performance benchmarks measure synthetic latency only (not E2E with actual enrichment APIs).
